question: India achieved polio eradication by 2014, and the last wild poliovirus case was recorded in 2011, primarily because oral polio vaccine (OPV) can induce intestinal mucosal immunity and limit faecal-oral transmission.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: This statement is true. India's last wild poliovirus case was in 2011 and WHO certified India polio-free in 2014. OPV's mucosal immunity is a key advantage for eradication strategies compared with IPV.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. India was certified polio-free in 2014. The last wild poliovirus case was in January 2011 in West Bengal. OPV's ability to generate intestinal mucosal IgA and interrupt faecal-oral transmission was central to eradication.
